chunks: And remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, men of power and insight.

key_terms.أُولِي الْأَيْدِي: Men of power or strength (physically and spiritually)

ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Uli al-Aydi wa al-Abasar' signify regarding the prophets Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the title 'Uli al-Aydi wa al-Abasar' is often interpreted to signify not only physical strength and keen vision but also the unique capacity of these patriarchs to wield divine authority and perceive spiritual truths, a trait later perfected in the Ahl al-Bayt. This verse underscores their role as archetypes of worship and endurance, linking their earthly struggles with their eternal spiritual stature in the lineage of Prophethood.
